title: Embedded help links with section fragments were rejected
summary: The initial embedded catalog published URI links with section fragments while lookup accepted only the complete base URI. Following a published recipe link returned unknown topic/resource. Fixed before delivery by removing the fragment before exact compiled-whitelist lookup, with full-document/canonical-base response; regression passed in final34-case native and sanitizer suites; independently reinspected.
evidence: verification.md, Embedding review defects and fixes; detailed final regressions in verification-embedding.md.

resolution.evidence: verification-embedding.md final native34/34 andASan/UBSan34/34; focused fragment/metadata regressions and independent source reinspection recorded in quality-review-embedding.md.
